issue.ticket_raw: i need vscode for development but it is blocked
issue.intent: Software Application Unblock via IFEO Debugger Entry Removal
issue.sop_title: Software Application Unblock via IFEO Debugger Entry Removal

steps.description: Verify endpoint connectivity to ensure remote administrative access is possible.
steps.output_parse_instruction: Check if output contains 'Reply from'. If not, set 'connectivity_failure' to 'true'.

steps.description: Identify if the application is blocked via an IFEO Debugger entry by querying the registry.
steps.command: reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\Code.exe"
steps.output:
HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\Code.exe
    Debugger    REG_SZ    cmd.exe /k echo VS Code blocked by IFEO
steps.output_parse_instruction: Inspect output. If 'Debugger' value is present, set 'ifeo_block_detected' to 'true'. If 'ERROR: The system was unable to find the specified registry key', set 'ifeo_block_detected' to 'false'.

steps.description: Remove the IFEO Debugger entry if Step 2 confirms its presence.
steps.command: reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\Code.exe" /v Debugger /f
steps.fallback_command: reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\{variables.application_exe}" /f
steps.danger_warning: This step modifies the Windows registry. Ensure the application is approved for unblocking before proceeding.
steps.output_parse_instruction: Check if output contains 'The operation completed successfully'. If not, set 'removal_failed' to 'true'.

steps.description: Refresh local Group Policy to apply changes immediately.
steps.output:
Updating policy...



Computer Policy update has completed successfully.

User Policy update has completed successfully.
steps.output_parse_instruction: Check if output contains 'Computer Policy update has completed successfully'. If not, set 'policy_refresh_failed' to 'true'.

steps.description: Verify that the IFEO block has been removed by re-querying the registry.
steps.command: reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\Code.exe"
steps.output_parse_instruction: Inspect output. If 'ERROR: The system was unable to find the specified registry key' or no 'Debugger' value is present, set 'block_removed' to 'true'.

final_responses.customer_ticket_reply:
## Issue Resolved: Visual Studio Code Unblock on Carnage
The issue with Visual Studio Code being blocked on your workstation, Carnage, has been successfully diagnosed and resolved. Our system detected an IFEO Debugger entry blocking the application and removed it. The steps involved checking connectivity, identifying the IFEO block, removing the Debugger entry, refreshing policies, and verifying the block removal. Your application should now be accessible.
